name: Subway
kurzbeschreibung:
**Subway in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover the **U-Bahn** in **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**—a unique urban transport experience in the heart of the Alps! The **U1** line connects the charming town center with the bustling **Partnachklamm** gorge and the scenic **Hausbergbahn** cable car station, offering quick and convenient access to nature and culture.

With just **one line** and **five stations**, this compact subway system is perfect for exploring **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**’s highlights. Hop on at **Hausberg** or **Partnachplatz** and enjoy a smooth ride through the mountains—all while staying dry, even in bad weather!

Ideal for tourists and locals alike, the **U-Bahn** makes getting around effortless. Combine your trip with a visit to the **Zugspitzbahn** or a stroll through the picturesque **Altstadt**, where traditional Bavarian charm awaits.

**Fun fact:** The **U-Bahn** in **Garmisch-Partenkirchen** is the world’s highest urban subway system—proof that adventure and convenience go hand in hand!
